digest.component_or_area: Reconciler bridge state / outbound comment recording
propositions: Successfully posted outbound Jira comments must have their returned comment IDs recorded in local binding store; divergence between posts succeeded and comment_ids unchanged indicates a recording failure that should trigger an alert.
Alert firing is debounced across 2 consecutive reconcile passes; an alert only fires when the same divergence is observed in both consecutive passes, not on the first divergent observation.
Posted comment count is tallied at the shared _record_comment_id seam before recording guards execute, capturing all successful posts even when the local recording step no-ops.

Cross-pass debounce state persists in bridge_state/comment_id_divergence.json; a healthy observation (no posts or posts with map growth) resets the counter to 0, while a divergent observation increments it until threshold.

A single divergent pass produces no alert; only the second consecutive divergent pass appends a bridge_alerts JSONL record with dedup key and pass_id, and a healthy pass between divergences resets the counter.
